title: tile-ai/tilelang
headline: TileLang simplifies writing GPU and CPU kernels
lede: You can write high-performance kernels for GPUs, CPUs and other accelerators in a domain-specific language.

effects.effect: Lower effort for custom kernels across accelerator types

possibilities.title: Kernel agents targeting TileLang could bring expert-grade kernels to chips lacking libraries

with.title: ForgeKernel agent writes faster attention prefill kernel

possibilities.connection: ForgeKernel's agent matched or beat 18 of 22 expert-library kernels on one GPU type, and TileLang gives it a single high-level target for GPUs, CPUs and other accelerators, so the same loop could produce fast kernels where no expert library exists.
